offering_description.value: Develops and sells inhaled medicines for diabetes and pulmonary disease, mainly Afrezza inhaled insulin sold by prescription to patients through specialty pharmacies, and earns royalties on an inhaled pulmonary hypertension therapy licensed to a partner company.

primary_products.value: inhaled insulin; inhaled treprostinil royalty stream

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty pharmacies, wholesalers, and licensing partners; B2C: adult patients with diabetes who use prescribed inhaled insulin

revenue_model.value: product sales: Afrezza inhaled insulin sold to pharmacies and wholesalers; licensing or royalties: royalties on sales of an inhaled pulmonary hypertension drug made by a licensee

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets Afrezza, sold to specialty pharmacies and wholesalers for patients; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures its inhaled insulin product at its own facilities from purchased ingredients

geography_served.value: US national: Sells prescription products across the United States

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on inhaled drug delivery, mainly Afrezza and royalties on an inhaled pulmonary hypertension drug

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty pharmacies and wholesale drug distributors; direct sales: sales representatives calling on physicians who prescribe diabetes treatments

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approval and marketing needed from the FDA for its inhaled medicines
